about: Nutrition, hydration and keeping values per food and drink good of the settlement-economy branch (PR.F8.T2, R23-R25, M69-M71). Per 100 g as bought (FAO retail weight). The generator tools/connector/food_values_edits.py computes the XML values from this file; nothing is typed into the XML by hand.

sources.FAO: FAO, Food Balance Sheets: a handbook (2001), Annex I food composition tables, per 100 g retail weight: https://www.fao.org/4/X9892E/X9892e05.htm
sources.DIAAS: Digestible Indispensable Amino Acid Score (FAO 2013 method), table for the 0.5-3-year reference pattern: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digestible_Indispensable_Amino_Acid_Score ; 'animal proteins, for example milk, whey and beef, generally have DIAAS greater than 100' (same page)
sources.Holt1995: Holt, Miller, Petocz, Farmakalidis, A satiety index of common foods, Eur J Clin Nutr 49 (1995) 675-90; table as reproduced at https://www.nutritionadvance.com/what-is-a-satiety-index-of-common-foods (beef 176, ling fish 225, cheese 146, white bread 100)
sources.Maughan2016: Maughan et al., A randomized trial to assess the potential of different beverages to affect hydration status, Am J Clin Nutr 103 (2016) 717-23: full-fat milk 1.50, skimmed milk 1.58, water 1.00; tea, coffee and lager not different from water at 4 h
sources.extraction: Stone milling about 80 % extraction, roller milling over 90 %; 60 lb of wheat gave 47-52 lb of flour: https://millsarchive.org/glossary/a-z-glossary/3051
sources.FAOstorage: FAO, post-harvest losses: traditional storage about 5 % a year; 20-40 % in poor storage: https://www.fao.org/4/w1544e/W1544E05.htm
sources.stockfish: Fish preservation: stockfish keeps several years; barrel-salted herring for long voyages: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fish_preservation

satiety.formula: satiety per kg = kcal per kg as bought x edible x (1 + k x p x q) / (1 + k x p_ref x q_ref); p = protein share of calories (4 kcal per g protein), q = DIAAS capped at 1
satiety.fit: k fitted so that beef against bread gives Holt's 176 against 100 (wheat's protein share and DIAAS stand in for white bread); checks: demersal fish 2.29 against Holt's ling fish 2.25, cheese 1.35 against 1.46
satiety.q_plant_basis: estimate: wheat's value for plants without a sourced DIAAS

fresh.basis: eaten in the year it is made

kept.basis: estimate: cheese, cured meat, salted fish

dried.basis: stockfish keeps several years; estimate for dried fruit

root.basis: estimate (open): potatoes and roots in store

BONUS_RICE.edible_basis: FAO paddy row is per paddy weight

BONUS_COW.edible_basis: boneless; per tonne of meat (carcass about 60 % of live weight, 80 % boneless: per head in tile_output)

BONUS_HORSE.note: secondary food use (feasts; the steppe); main role draught and mounts

BONUS_WHALE.note: food per tonne of meat; the good is counted in barrels of oil today (proposals.json): unit mapping open

BONUS_OLIVES.note: olive oil 884 kcal per 100 g if pressed (recipe, open)

BONUS_WINE.hydration_basis: estimate: Maughan2016 measured lager, not wine

BONUS_ALCOHOL.hydration_basis: Maughan2016 lager not different from water

BONUS_TEA.hydration_basis: Maughan2016 tea not different from water; litres brewed per tonne of leaf open

BONUS_COFFEE.hydration_basis: Maughan2016 coffee not different from water; litres brewed per tonne of beans open

BONUS_SALT.role: preserver (D27 option A): moves meat and fish from fresh to kept
